subject: Lyra Inc. trial alignment — success KPIs, timelines, ownership
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@lyra.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom@lyra.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial KPI slate (Lyra)

Hi Sarah / Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single reference for the trial kickoff.

Top-level objective:
- Validate Lyra's document-summarization pipeline at production scale with a focus on latency, token economics, and end-user quality.

Proposed acceptance KPIs (initial):
- Latency: 95th percentile request-to-first-token <= 350ms for 512-token prompts under steady-state traffic.
- Throughput: sustained 60 requests/sec per model instance for a 1k concurrent worker profile.
- Cost: average cost/token (inference only) target <= $0.0009 per token with recommended quantization and batching.
- Quality: human-annotated ROUGE-L >= 0.62 on Lyra's representative dataset OR user-satisfaction > 4/5 on a 50-sample blind test.
- Error budget: <= 0.5% of requests returning runtime failures or timeouts per day.

Evaluation plan / timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): exchange input sample spec and sandbox credentials. (Action: Lyra — provide 500 doc samples + schema)
- Week 1: Redwood will spin sandbox, run baseline with our curated open model (quantized) and provide perf baseline report. (Action: Redwood — Mateo; Ops lead: Kimberly)
- Week 2: Integration test with Lyra preprocessor and 2 live workload patterns; iterate on batching/kv-cache settings. (Action: Lyra + Redwood)
- Week 3: Quality validation (50 blinded samples) and cost run for 24-hour traffic window; decision gate on going to a short production pilot.

Owners (first pass):
- Redwood technical lead / contact: Mateo Alvarez (trial orchestration, perf readouts)
- Redwood ops / SRE: Kimberly Park (sandbox provisioning, logs, SLO instrumentation)
- Customer lead: Sarah Lee (data/schema, evaluation set)
- Exec sponsor: Tom Reynolds (success criteria signoff)

Attachments: I attached the input sample schema we discussed and a draft mutual action plan. Please confirm whether the KPI targets above look reasonable or if Lyra wants to propose alternate thresholds (particularly for cost/token and ROUGE cutoff).

Next steps (please reply inline):
1) Sarah: share sample files and any redaction requirements by EOD Mon PT.
2) Tom: confirm decision gate owner for the quality threshold (ROUGE vs user-satisfaction).
3) Kimberly: I will coordinate sandbox creds + expected logs to share with your infra team.

Thanks — Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Lead Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@lyra.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom@lyra.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial KPI slate (Lyra)

Thanks Mateo — this is helpful and aligns with what we outlined. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- For latency, our SLA target is more aggressive (tail p95 <= 250ms) — we can try 350ms for the first run but would like to see a path to 250ms with quantized models.
- On cost/token: our finance team wants a mid-trial checkpoint on actual run costs before we commit to quantization profiles that impact quality. Can we add a Week 2 cost checkpoints item?
- Quality: Lyra prefers user-satisfaction as the decision gate (we do a blind user-study), but we'll share ROUGE alignments as supporting data.

We'll upload the 500 sample docs (redacted) to the Drive folder by Monday. Also adding a 1-page privacy note: some documents contain PII; we'll include a redaction script as discussed.

Two asks on logistics: 
1) Can Redwood provide a simple runbook for how you'll measure cost/token (which tokens counted, pricing assumptions)?
2) Who will be the escalation contact if we hit runtime errors in the sandbox outside business hours?

Tom and I are available Tues morning for a short sync if you want to lock owners.

— Sarah
Lead Product Manager | Lyra Inc.
sarah.lee@lyra.ai
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@lyra.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom@lyra.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial KPI slate (Lyra)

Appreciate the quick reply, Sarah. Short answers and an updated plan below.

1) Latency: we can run Week 1 baseline at the 350ms target to validate the workload shape and then attempt optimizations (kernel selection, reduced context, faster model variant) for Week 2 to approach 250ms. We'll document the optimization steps and expected tradeoffs.

2) Cost checkpoint: added — Week 2 mid-run cost checkpoint (24h sampling) and weekly cost roll-up in the mutual action plan.

3) Quality gate: we'll make user-satisfaction the primary decision gate; ROUGE as auxiliary metric. Please confirm the user-study rubric (Likert scale / blind labels) when you upload.

Runbook + escalation: attached a short runbook (cost calc method + what counts as a token) and a 24/7 escalation contact: Ben Carter (pager: ben.carter@redwood.ai — he'll rotate for on-call). Kimberly will handle sandbox provisioning during business hours.

Updated timeline (high level):
- Mon (6/22): Lyra uploads samples + redaction script -> Redwood validates format.
- Tue (6/23): Redwood starts baseline perf run (Report by EOD Wed).
- Thu (6/25): Mid-trial cost checkpoint + preliminary user-satisfaction run (50 samples).
- Mon (6/29): Go / No-go decision for 3-week production pilot.

I've attached the mutual action plan (v1) and an XLS with the sample schema columns we discussed. If that's acceptable I'll convert MAP into a shared doc and add tasks.

Next steps: Sarah to confirm upload by EOD Mon; Tom to confirm exec signoff criteria (I put a placeholder in the MAP).

Thanks — Mateo

Attachments: redwood_runbook_cost_calc.pdf; lyra_input_sample_spec.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@lyra.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom@lyra.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial KPI slate (Lyra)

Quick operational notes from my side after reviewing the runbook: 
- I'll be the after-hours pager for the sandbox (primary) for the next two weeks. Escalation path: Ben -> Mateo -> Redwood SRE on-call.
- We should instrument a token-level breakdown in the baseline report (prompt tokens / completion tokens / internal overhead) so Lyra's finance folks can map to their model choices.
- Suggest we add a short acceptance test: 10 randomized documents where latency + quality must both meet thresholds to pass the Week 2 gate.

I'll stand up the alert hooks and hook you all into the Ops Slack channel. Mateo/Kimberly — can you confirm I have permission to create the Workspace alert channel?

Ben
Director, Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
